scope: Product screenshot preprocessing and unresolved-match UI; no trained weights, enrolled families or confidence settings changed.

regression_checks.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_screenshot_crops.py tests/test_analysis.py tests/test_category_ensemble.py tests/test_extended_matching.py tests/test_font_identity.py tests/test_font_matching.py tests/test_glyph_and_variations.py tests/test_independent_fonts.py tests/test_poster_matching.py tests/test_retrieval_runtime.py tests/test_vercel_deployment.py

reference_parity.method: All available open-font styles, four enrollment phrases and lower/title/upper case; compare normalized pixels from legacy and selected crop behavior. Existing font binaries not committed.

final_protocol: Final candidate frozen after development and decorative-grid regression correction; test3 uses 13 families excluding the initial 15 test2 families. Four related transforms per base crop; historical browser-corpus reuse explicitly disclosed.

unknown_regression.status: Reused families; diagnostic, not untouched final evidence

user_fixture.source: User-provided app screenshot; cropped to the text image only. No font program included.
